{{Quote|You don't know who the Baragwin are? They're the best damn weapons merchants in the galaxy, that's who they are! They were in space selling arms to the highest bidder before my species even got off our homeworld. Their weapons are the highest quality you can find, too. Better than either the Republic OR the Sith.|[[Suvam Tan]]|<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Baragwin''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]] native to the lost [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Old Barag/Legends|Old Barag]]. One of the earliest spacefaring races, the Baragwin could be found across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
A hunchbacked [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]], the bipedal Baragwin were easily recognized across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Noted for their thick, wrinkled skin which could resist most physical attacks and their shuffling gait, the large-headed race had no obvious differences between [[Gender/Legends|male and female]] Baragwin.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> An acute sense of smell gave the species enough sensitivity to detect another being's mood and feelings. This led some of them into careers as big-game hunters, or even as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="GG12" /> Due to their ponderous movement, many non-Baragwin believed the race to be a dull-witted people while, in fact, they were quite intelligent. Despite this fact, the Baragwin frequently kept this intelligence hidden, using the misconceptions of others to their own advantage.<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Society and culture==
Baragwin culture, since it did not derive from a single homeworld, was highly dependent on a Baragwin's planet of origin, with [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] Baragwin behaving quite differently from those from [[Denuhi-Eight]]. Baragwin generally had little prejudice, treating all other beings equally regardless of species, culture, or planetary origins, though criminal Baragwin would exploit all beings equally instead. Baragwin settlements were generally small and anarchic, with short-term leaders selected by informal democratic processes.<ref name="GG12" />

Most Baragwin had a first and a second name. Common names included Dagel Igara, Digo Fadani, and Idalli Kodrue.<ref name="UAA" /> Senator Wynl, who apparently had only one name, was one of the few known exceptions.<ref name="DTI">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Sith were building a whole lot of temples on Yavin IV by Exar Kun's order, and they needed people to build it for them... so they got slaves. Most of the slaves were put to work on the buildings directly, but there are a lot of other things you need to make a planet a working base. Weapons, for instance. So they forced some Baragwin to work for them making weapons.|Suvam Tan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
[[File:Baragwin_GG12.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Baragwin brandishing his weapons]]

Originating from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Old Barag/Legends|Old Barag]], the Baragwin left their world long in the past, eventually leading the species and the [[galactic community]] to forget its location, as well as the Baragwins' [[Baragwinian|native language]]. Though their population numbered only in the millions, they were widespread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], having been part of galactic society for millennia. While Old Barag was lost to history, Baragwin, like [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Duro/Legends|Duros]], identified themselves with the planet they were raised on.<ref name="GG12" />

Baragwin were famous as skilled weapon-smiths and introduced many different weapons to different worlds. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Baragwin-made [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] were among the most powerful personal weapons in the galaxy.<ref name="KotOR" /> This tradition continued into the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] era, where Baragwin were found working for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-backed corporations, criminals, and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GG12" /> Since the Empire and Imperial-backed corporations prized the contribution of Baragwin weapons engineering, most Baragwin supported the Empire during the Galactic Civil War. When [[Ysanne Isard]] released the [[Krytos virus]] in order to decimate the nonhuman population of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], however, the planet's Baragwin community was hit hard. The majority of Baragwin reacted by throwing their support behind the fledgling [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="UAA" /> By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the numerous Baragwin communities were represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Wynl]].<ref name="DTI" />

==Baragwin in the galaxy==
[[File:Astaal_Vilbum.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Astaal Vilbum]], a noted [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]]]
As they claimed no species homeworld, the Baragwin affiliated themselves with the world on which they had established colonies or enclaves which could be found anywhere in the galaxy. Connected to arms dealing and manufacturing, most prolific Baragwin worked in the underworld arming criminals or working with local military forces to arm against insurgences. Among the Baragwin armorers at that time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] was [[Hermi Odle/Legends|Hermi Odle]], a security expert working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], a well-known crime lord.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] among the Baragwin were rare, and with such a small population existing in the galaxy, almost unheard of. One of the few to gain notoriety was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Astaal Vilbum]], [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and the leader of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] during the last decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
